translation:
Treats all afflictions of the eye.

Use Huanglian powder and Ruiren with the skin removed and ground, each in equal parts as above. Take two jujubes, open the head a little, remove the pit, fill them full with the medicine, then close the jujube head again and wrap in silk. In a silver pot decoct one bowl of water down to a small half, strain it up, wait for it to cool, and wash the eye; it is immediately effective. (Use jujubes that are large and well-formed)
translator_notes: 蕤仁 (Ruiren) is a medicine used for eye disease.
開頭少許 (open the head a little) means opening the top of the jujube slightly.
